name: Fogreach Cave
description: A long cave that cuts through the mountain toward the valley of Hazevale.

entry.name: Cave Entry
entry.description: Cold stone and damp air. The daylight fades behind you.

bat_roost.name: Bat Roost
bat_roost.description: The ceiling is a mass of sleeping wings.

crystal_pool.name: Crystal Pool
crystal_pool.description: A quiet pool ringed by pale crystals. An iron chest lies half-buried near the water.

narrow_ledge.name: Narrow Ledge
narrow_ledge.description: A ledge along a drop into darkness. An imp watches from the far end.

cave_exit.name: Far Exit
cave_exit.description: Grey light and thin fog. The valley of Hazevale lies below.
